decision.summary: A multi-sample cross-axis shift occurs in N and E between indices 485–494: N increases ~1.9 MAD, E decreases ~0.8 MAD over ~10 samples. The abruptness and coherence suggest a transient offset, but missing data (496–498) and lack of unambiguous opposing return within allowed context [450,579] preclude confirmation. U shows no consistent response. No other temporary offsets identified in the allowed window.

Missing samples at 496–498 prevent confirmation of return; subsequent values (idx 499 onward) show N/E continuing in new regime without clear opposing reversal. No sustained platform or clean return observed within allowed context.
